description: This file defines the main Activity for a Bluetooth chat application on Android. It manages the UI components, Bluetooth connections, message handling, and user interactions for a Bluetooth-based chat session.

classes.name: BluetoothChat
classes.description: Main activity class managing Bluetooth chat session, UI, and connection lifecycle.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Ensures Bluetooth is enabled, initiates chat setup.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Starts Bluetooth services if not already started.

methods.name: setupChat
methods.description: Sets up UI components and Bluetooth service for chat.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Stops Bluetooth service on activity destruction.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message over Bluetooth if connected.

methods.name: mWriteListener
methods.description: Listener for send message action when user presses return.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Updates the ActionBar subtitle to reflect current status.

methods.name: mHandler
methods.description: Handles messages from BluetoothChatService to update UI and state.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles results from enable Bluetooth and device selection activities.

methods.name: connectDevice
methods.description: Initiates connection to selected Bluetooth device.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates options menu for selecting connection options.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections for device connection and discoverability.
